Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1375
Claimant:
Kevin Jordan
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2024-07-24
Claim reported by the policyholder's household member after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The claimant reoprts
a knee injury and is represented by counsel, so all contact will go thorugh the attorney's office.
2024-07-30
Obtained the police report and contacted the other driver, who described the lane change and contact in the same
way the claimant did. Two independent witnesses were also reached and their accounts are consistent.
2024-08-03
Reviewed the photos submitted from the scene. The damage is mostly along the expected line of the described
impact, and the claimant's vehicle shows no sign of earlier damage in the same areas.
2024-08-08
Confirmed with the police and the witnesses that the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision. The driver
is listed on the policy as a household member, so coverage applies under the policy terms.
2024-10-06
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who provided the initial medical summary. The reported knee injury fits the kind
and force of the collision, and no prior injury to that body area is known from the records available so far.
2024-10-09
Recorded the claimant's account by phone. The version given is the same as the one provided at first notice,
including the sequence of the lane change and the point of impact.
2024-10-26
Verified the policy effective date and reviewed the vehicle history. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates
the start of coverage.
2024-11-13
Treatment has grown steadily since the first report, with more visits and new services added each month. That
pattern is well beyond what this type of knee injury usually requires, so the file has been flagged for a medical review.
2025-01-19
Sent the damage estimate, the medical review request and the statement summaries to the supervisor for a
settlement authority decision. The attorney has been notified that the file is under review and that a response on the
medical question is pending.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
